name: Detective Baba Takeshi
source: 38 years old and a detective based in the Tokyo Police Department. Ryo meets him when Baba Takeshi is tasked with finding his missing sister. The Detective is often untrusted due to his age and somewhat laid back nature. While he can seem unprofessional at times, he has nothing but good intentions. He’s addicted to chewing tobacco and often invades personal space. He speaks lazily and sometimes uses foul language.
